method: Joint developer-block bootstrap of interaction regression on 2560 usable-throughput battles and identity-only leaderboard MAP on all2580. Same cluster multiplicities in both fits. For each draw, project Carbon identity at122TPS across fixed191Carbon matchups/early flags, solve syntheticNeon Elo against that draw’s opponent ratings, subtract that draw’s Opus5.5 Elo. Percentile intervals. PriorSD400Elo.
interpretation: Exploratory model-conditional uncertainty, not direct experimental evidence about Neon. Margins20/25/35/50 are illustrations, not preregistered practical-equivalence bounds. Includes estimation covariance; excludes uncertainty that Neon quality differs from Carbon, throughput changes, or early-vote behavior changes.
